Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**Levels**

Solution
========
The set of values that a factor takes in the experiment. The number of combinations of a full factorial design is the product of the number of levels of every factor.
